verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Aggregation, verification, publication, feedback calibration, and head-change recovery are strongly covered: deduplication, severity reconciliation, confidence filtering, stale-location dropping, high-severity recheck, demotion, publication outcomes, threshold feedback, cancellation, discard, and restart are all visibly represented.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The normal reviewer fan-out does not identify the required specialist roster. Performance, test-coverage, and API-compatibility reviewers are absent, while correctness and security are only partially inferable from the over-budget degraded mode.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board covers most of the lifecycle and its principal failure, recovery, publication, telemetry, and calibration behaviors. Weighted coverage is 75/91 = 0.8242, which reaches the rubric's raw 7 anchor. However, three absent system-defining reviewer specializations trigger the RC cap of 6. Additional smaller gaps include unnamed reviewer tools, missing per-review/no-delay qualifiers, omitted context-budget causality, and the unstated false-positive priority.
